> **Module-specific documentation issues** belong on the module repo. If you found a doc problem in `townlight_records` or `townlight_core`, file there.

## What kind of issue?

- [ ] Typo / grammar
- [ ] Broken link
- [ ] Outdated fact (e.g. version numbers, dates, repo URLs)
- [ ] Unclear or confusing explanation
- [ ] Missing content
- [ ] Other (describe)

## Where is it?

- File path (e.g. `README.md`, `USER-MANUAL.md`, `docs/index.html`, `docs/compatibility/index.md`):
- Section / heading / line number:

## Quote the current text

```
(paste the current text or link to the line)
```

## What should it say?

Suggested replacement, correction, or addition. If you don't have an exact wording, describe what the reader needs to know.

## Why this matters

Who is misled, blocked, or confused by the current state?

## Checklist

- [ ] I've confirmed this is in the umbrella repo, not a module repo
- [ ] I've checked existing issues for duplicates
